content.value: There are 1.45 kg of a gas, for which R = 0.375 kJ/kgK and k = 1.25, that undergo a non- 1 flow constant volume process from p1 = 540 kPa and t1 = 55°C to p2 = 1600 kPa. During the process the gas is internally stirred, and there are also added 100 kJ of heat. Determine t2, Q, ∆U and work output.
